driver: The decisive quantity is a sum of per-entity capped sums in which each entity must first be constituted from child records by the child's own location rather than the parent record's administrative address, so regrouping children moves the total through the cap without changing any child's value.
driver_concrete: Each emission unit is seated at its own parcel and grouped into sources by ultimate controller, surveyed section and two-digit group, so the 33 multi-site permits split across sources and the 125-ton per-pollutant ceiling lifts the fee from 1,270,916 to 1,468,358 dollars.
